channel.title: EnergyPricesToday — Live Oil Prices, Gas Prices, Energy Geopolitics
channel.description: Daily updates on oil prices, U.S. gas prices, electricity rates, and energy geopolitics.

item.title: U.S. Navy Disables Two Iranian Tankers; Trump Calls Strike a 'Love Tap'
item.description: U.S. forces fired Friday May 8 on two empty Iranian oil tankers (M/T Sea Star III and M/T Sevda) that attempted to evade the naval blockade. CENTCOM said a Navy warplane fired into the smokestacks and disabled both vessels. Trump called the strikes 'just a love tap' and insisted the ceasefire remains in effect.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: U.S. Awaits Iran Response to 14-Point Memorandum to End Hormuz War
item.description: U.S. and Iran are reportedly close to a 14-point memorandum of understanding that would end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Iran would commit to a uranium enrichment moratorium; the U.S. would lift sanctions and release frozen funds. Iran's formal response expected through Pakistan.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: AAA Gas Average Hits $4.55, Up 25 Cents for Second Straight Week
item.description: AAA reported the U.S. national average for regular gasoline reached $4.546 per gallon Friday May 8 — up 25 cents for the second straight week. Pump prices are now $1.40 higher than a year ago and at their highest level since 2022. Despite crude pulling back below $100, retail prices continue to climb on multi-day pass-through lag.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Iran's Mohsen Rezaei Demands U.S. Reparations Before Any Deal
item.description: Mohsen Rezaei, member of Iran's Expediency Council, said via state news agency PressTV that the U.S. must pay reparations for damage done to Iran before any settlement. The hardline framing complicates the 14-point memorandum even as Iranian negotiators continue Pakistan-mediated talks.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Oil Crashes 13% Intraday as U.S.-Iran MOU Talks Emerge
item.description: WTI crude crashed as much as 13.2% intraday Tuesday May 5 to a low of $88.71 — first sub-$90 print since April 21. Brent plummeted as much as 12% to $96.77 low. The crash followed news that U.S. and Iran were close to a 14-point memorandum of understanding to end the war.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Trump Declines to Confirm Ceasefire as Both Sides Trade Fire in Strait
item.description: President Trump on Monday May 4 declined to say whether the April 8 ceasefire with Iran remains in place. The hostilities directly contradict Trump's letter to Congress on Friday claiming 'no exchange of fire' since April 7 and that 'hostilities have terminated' under the War Powers Resolution.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: WTI Surges to $105, Brent Tops $114 on Hormuz Exchange of Fire
item.description: WTI jumped 3% Monday to settle at $105.09. Brent rallied nearly 6% to settle at $114.44 — its highest close since May 2022. Both benchmarks briefly spiked higher intraday on reports of a U.S. frigate strike that CENTCOM later denied.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Iran Strikes UAE Fujairah Oil Hub; First Major Bypass Infrastructure Hit
item.description: Iran launched 19 missiles and drones at the UAE on Monday May 4. Most were intercepted, but a drone struck the Fujairah Oil Industry Zone, sparking a major fire and wounding three Indian nationals. Fujairah is the terminus of the UAE pipeline that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: U.S. Sinks Seven Iranian Boats as Project Freedom Launches Hormuz Convoys
item.description: CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper said Monday May 4 that U.S. forces opened a passage through the Strait of Hormuz free of Iranian mines and sank seven small Iranian boats targeting civilian ships. Two U.S.-flagged merchant vessels successfully transited Hormuz under Project Freedom.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: U.S. Gas Average Climbs to $4.46, Up Another 6 Cents Over Weekend
item.description: AAA reported Monday May 4 the U.S. national average for regular gasoline reached $4.457 per gallon, up from $4.392 Friday. Tennessee crossed $4 for the first time since July 2022. California averaging above $6.11. National average $1.29 higher than year-ago.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Explained: Why This 21-Mile Waterway Controls Global Oil
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most important oil chokepoint — 20 million barrels per day, 25% of global seaborne oil, 20% of global LNG. Here's why this 21-mile-wide waterway moves global energy markets, who depends on it, and what happens if it closes.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: U.S. Gas Average Surges to $4.39, Up 25 Cents in Three Days
item.description: AAA reported Friday May 1 that the U.S. national average for regular gasoline reached $4.392 per gallon — the highest since July 2022 and up 25 cents in three days. Michigan spiked to $4.86 on a Midwest refinery issue; California averages $6.45.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Iran Sends Updated Peace Proposal Through Pakistan; Trump ’Not Satisfied’
item.description: Pakistani officials confirmed Friday May 1 that Iranian mediators delivered an updated peace proposal to the U.S. through Islamabad. President Trump told reporters he was unsatisfied with the offer; oil prices retraced from Thursday's 4-year highs.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Chevron Posts Biggest Earnings Beat Since 2020 on Record Production
item.description: Chevron reported Q1 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.41 versus a $0.95 estimate — its biggest earnings beat since October 2020. GAAP profit was $2.2 billion / $1.11 per share after a $2.9B charge tied to financial hedges. Production rose 15% YoY to 3.9 million bpd.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: ExxonMobil Q1 Profit Falls to 5-Year Low at $4.2B Despite Beating Estimates
item.description: ExxonMobil reported Q1 2026 net income of $4.2 billion — its lowest in five years — but beat Wall Street estimates with $1.16 adjusted EPS and $85.14 billion in revenue. Production hit 4.6 million bpd; Guyana set a quarterly record above 900,000 gross bpd.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Mojtaba Khamenei Vows to Retain Nuclear and Missile Capabilities
item.description: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei pledged this week not to relinquish the country's nuclear or missile capabilities and indicated Tehran would retain control over the Strait of Hormuz, complicating prospects for a comprehensive U.S.-Iran deal.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Trump Briefed on Expanded Iran Military Options as Crude Hit 4-Year High
item.description: Reports Thursday April 30 that CENTCOM Adm. Brad Cooper briefed President Trump on expanded military options against Iran sent WTI crude to a 4-year intraday high of $111 and Brent to $114 — the highest level since June 2022 — before profit-taking trimmed gains.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: WTI Tops $100, Brent $111 on Iran Hormuz Proposal Uncertainty
item.description: WTI crude futures jumped more than 3% Tuesday April 28 to settle above $99.93, with Brent above $111.26 as markets weighed Iran's new Hormuz proposal and Trump's skepticism. The 7th consecutive session of gains pushed both benchmarks to highs not seen since early April.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: U.S. Gas Average Hits $4.14, Highest in Nearly Four Years
item.description: AAA reported Tuesday April 28 that the U.S. national average for regular gasoline rose to $4.144 per gallon, the highest level in nearly four years. Diesel reached $5.689. Crude oil's seven-session rally to $99.93 WTI is feeding through to retail prices.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Trump Says Iran in ’State of Collapse’ as Hormuz Standoff Drags Into Ninth Week
item.description: President Trump posted Tuesday April 28 that Iran had informed the U.S. it was in 'a State of Collapse' and wanted Hormuz reopened. The post came as the U.S. weighs Iran's Monday proposal to lift the blockade in exchange for reopening the strait.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Iran Proposes Hormuz Reopening if U.S. Lifts Naval Blockade
item.description: Iran submitted a formal proposal Monday April 27 to reopen the Strait of Hormuz if the U.S. lifts its naval blockade and ends military operations, while postponing nuclear talks for a later phase. Trump and his national security team discussed the offer; early indications suggest the proposal is unlikely to be accepted in its current form.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Araghchi Leaves Pakistan Without Meeting U.S. Officials as Talks Collapse
item.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi left Islamabad Sunday April 26 without meeting any U.S. officials, after Trump cancelled the Witkoff-Kushner trip. Pakistani mediation continues but direct talks remain stalled.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Trump Cancels Witkoff-Kushner Pakistan Trip as Iran Talks Stall
item.description: Trump cancelled the planned trip of U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner to Islamabad on Saturday April 25, halting the second round of U.S.-Iran peace talks before it could begin.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: WTI Surges 13% on Week as Hormuz Stays Closed and Talks Stall
item.description: WTI crude rose 13% on the week and Brent rose 18%, the biggest weekly gains since early March, as Hormuz stayed closed and U.S.-Iran diplomacy deadlocked. WTI settled at $94.7, Brent at $104.4.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Israeli Strikes Kill Lebanese Journalist Amal Khalil During Extended Ceasefire
item.description: Lebanese journalist Amal Khalil was killed and others wounded in an Israeli strike April 22, sharply straining the extended Israel-Lebanon ceasefire. Multiple new strikes followed across south Lebanon.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Trump Orders Navy to 'Shoot and Kill' Iranian Mine-Laying Vessels in Strait
item.description: President Trump ordered the U.S. Navy to 'shoot and kill' Iranian small boats laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz, marking a sharp escalation in U.S. enforcement posture.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: U.S. Boards Supertanker Carrying Iranian Oil in Indian Ocean
item.description: U.S. forces boarded a supertanker carrying Iranian oil in the Indian Ocean April 22, signaling that interdiction operations now extend well beyond the Persian Gulf and naval blockade zone.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Trump Extends Iran Ceasefire Indefinitely, Citing 'Seriously Fractured' Iranian Government
item.description: Trump extended the U.S.-Iran ceasefire indefinitely via Truth Social on April 21, citing a 'seriously fractured' Iranian government at the request of Pakistan.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: U.S. Naval Blockade of Iranian Ports Remains in Place Despite Ceasefire Extension
item.description: Trump's ceasefire extension keeps the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports in place. 28 ships have been turned back. Iran calls blockade an 'act of war.'
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff

item.title: Energy Stocks Mixed as Ceasefire Extension Eases but Blockade Stays
item.description: Energy sector stocks traded mixed Tuesday as Trump's ceasefire extension eased geopolitical tension but the continuing blockade kept supply-disruption premiums elevated.
item.dc:creator: EnergyPricesToday Staff
